question: Which of the following is non-biodegradable?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nylon**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nylon **is non-biodegradable, while cotton and wool are biodegradable**
 
• **Nylon**
 
 
• **​**A **synthetic fiber that is non-biodegradable and cannot be broken down. **
 
• **Synthetic products are usually non-biodegradable because they are man-made.**
 
• Washing machines can release microplastics from nylon into the environment.
